source_title: Solved Sudden Drop In Etsy Sales And No Search Visibility 6 9Th November 2025
snippet_primary: "On the 6th of November, our sales went from 1.2k per day, to £20 -Etsy support were no help, stating it was just our SEO. It was clear that it wasn't, as we just weren't visible in search. Our shop name wasn't coming up, nada."
subject_exact: seller-reported Etsy sales decline attributed to lost search visibility, disputed by Etsy support's SEO explanation
metric_value_raw: sales dropped from ~1.2k/day to £20; shop name not appearing in search
parser_notes: Mixed units declared: currency-denominated sales figure alongside a discoverability observation.
